source_method.market_data: BTCUSD Bitstamp Spot; hourly resampling; source study period 2011-09-13 through 2019-12-12.
source_method.paper_parameter_domain: Short and long moving-average windows are described as varying from 1 to 1000 hours for BTCUSD.
source_method.observed_code_grid: The bound notebook searches n1=range(1,1000,10), n2=range(1,1000,10), constrained by n1<n2, separately for SMA/EMA/DEMA.
source_method.entry_rule: Bullish crossover: the short moving average crosses above the long moving average.
source_method.exit_rule: Bearish crossover: the short moving average crosses below the long moving average; source code calls sell().
source_method.optimization_objective: Sharpe Ratio on each training year.
source_method.walk_forward: Optimize each one-year training slice, then apply that frozen n1/n2 pair to the following one-year test slice.
source_method.source_cost_model: The paper states transaction fees, bid-offer spread, slippage and market impact are assumed negligible.
source_method.source_gap_handling: Source hourly data forward-fills missing observations.
paper_code_discrepancies: Paper describes 1-1000 hour parameter ranges while the observed notebook uses a step-10 grid range(1,1000,10).
Source code uses buy/sell semantics while YATL is long-only Spot; YATL must translate bearish crossover to exit-to-cash rather than short exposure.
Source forward-fills missing hourly data while YATL accepted historical corpus does not interpolate accepted source gaps.
Source assumes negligible trading costs while YATL must include fee and adverse slippage.

yatl_adaptation.entry_rule: Enter long on a completed-bar bullish short-over-long moving-average crossover.
yatl_adaptation.exit_rule: Exit to cash on a completed-bar bearish short-under-long moving-average crossover; never open a short.
yatl_adaptation.gap_handling: Use accepted YATL historical gap semantics; do not forward-fill missing source intervals.
yatl_adaptation.source_fidelity: ADAPTED_REPLICATION: signal family and train-to-next-year walk-forward concept are preserved, while shorting, zero-cost assumptions and source gap filling are not.

train_search.parameter_grid: Three independent families. For each family, n1 and n2 are selected from range(1,1000,10), constrained by n1<n2. This yields exactly 4,950 trials per family and 14,850 total trials; no outcome-based pruning is permitted.
train_search.selection_scope: All 14,850 trials are Development-only. Every executed or failed trial counts toward the HSSE multiple-testing ledger. Blind OOS and audit holdout are not read.
